Name: Male Bachelorettes - Female Genderbend
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
Dolphins may not be fishes, but damn they are good at jumping people and scope creeping them huh.

Hey you! Did ya ever want to turn the bachelorettes into bachelors? Did ya ever want to see what they may look if they were the other gender? [size=1]No? Okay....[/size]
[size=3]Anyways here is a Female genderbend mod! I got asked for a portrait mod like this, didn't found anything really so I just decided to make one myself! I'm not all too convinced on how some ended up looking in pixel art but hey, at least is here! I will be dropping an HD version soon (also a male genderbend too cause we need to be fair to both lol).[/size]
I will also be doing some Wedding reception things for this and some seasonal stuff in the near future.
[size=3]This one was done in time for the modfest thank god.[/size]

[color=#ff0000][size=5]Beware that this mod only changes the sprites and portraits, I did not touch the dialogues, for that you can go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44271]DolphinIsNotAFish dialogue mod[/url] for the dialogue changes, this mod is meant to be the art part of that one![/size][/color]
